**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION APPROVAL**

**Patient Service:** Laparoscopic Sleeve Gastrectomy (CPT 43775)  
**Order Date:** May 31, 2025  
**Decision:** APPROVED

---

**Clinical Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement:** Met. Current BMI is 46.1 kg/m² (obs-002), exceeding the required minimum of 35 kg/m².

**Obesity-Related Comorbidity:** Met. Patient has Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications (E11.9), documented as active since June 8, 2019 (cond-003). This qualifies as an obesity-related comorbid condition.

**Prior Medical Treatment:** Met. Medical record documents completion of a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial (doc-004). Patient achieved minimal weight loss of 2 kg, which was regained after discontinuation. This unsuccessful trial satisfies the prior conservative treatment requirement.

**Covered Procedure:** Met. Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (CPT 43775) is an approved bariatric procedure.

---

This authorization is valid for 60 days from this letter. Please contact us if you have questions.
